intro_say: Hi friends! I'm Stompy! Let's rhyme!

song:

star and car,

A sock, a block,
here they are!

Words that sound
alike will rhyme,

youtube.title: Stompy's Rhyme Time! Dog and Frog (STOMP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦖 STOMP! Stompy the dino took one big step and all the rhyming words flew away! Can you help Stompy find them?

Learn rhyming words with Stompy: DOG and FROG, STAR and CAR, SOCK and BLOCK! Visit the park, the pond, the night sky, the road, the snow and the classroom, and hear the REAL sounds of the dog, the frog and the car. Then sing Stompy's rhyming song, and stay till the end, because something is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn what rhyming words are
✔️ Hear 3 rhyming pairs: dog/frog, star/car, sock/block
✔️ Practice listening for the same end sound
✔️ Sing a rhyming song with Stompy!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Stompy!
0:04 STOMP! Oh no!
0:09 Let's learn rhyming words!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 Who's behind the board?
0:56 What rhymes with cat?

💬 What rhymes with cat? Tell Stompy in the comments!
